item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We refuse to confuse greater intelligence with loyalty to humanity. Capability is not consent.

2. We believe humanity must choose its own future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We reject a race that puts that future beyond human control.

3. We will not accept a future governed by goals no human chose. That is what superintelligent AI will pursue if it is built within the next 20 years. We demand that human agency come before the race to build it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We reject the idea that intelligence alone guarantees allegiance to humanity. Building a system more capable than we are does not give us control over what it ultimately seeks. We cannot treat our collective future as an experiment whose objectives are set beyond our reach. We stand for human agency, public accountability, and the right to decide what kind of world we build. We demand that these commitments take precedence over competitive pressure, corporate ambition, and the race to create superintelligence.
